## Summary

Describe the purpose of this change and the documents or components it affects.

## Formalization checklist

- [ ] Each edited document has a clear purpose and an appropriate place in the repository.
- [ ] Canonical references are linked instead of duplicated.
- [ ] Technical statements remain evidence-based; uncertainty is labeled.
- [ ] Relative links and code examples have been checked.
- [ ] The documentation inventory is regenerated if Markdown paths changed.
- [ ] No file under `old-files/` has been edited, moved, renamed, reformatted, or deleted.
- [ ] Runtime-facing localized text preserves its language, tokens, command names, and file paths.

## Validation

List the checks run and any checks that could not be run.

## Related issue or research

Link related issue, experiment, or evidence if applicable.
